mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= CURDATE()
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM orders WHERE created_at >= CURDATE() AND status IN (1, 2, 3)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 0

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.date, '%m-%d') AS `date`, IFNULL(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS amount, COUNT(o.id) AS cnt FROM ( SELECT DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL n DAY) AS date FROM ( SELECT 0 AS n UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 ) t ) d LEFT JOIN orders o ON DATE(o.created_at) = d.date GROUP BY d.date ORDER BY d.date ASC
SELECT c.name AS name, COUNT(oi.id) AS cnt FROM order_item oi JOIN product p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN category c ON p.category_id = c.id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY cnt DESC
